seo.title: Best Brunch Spots in Casablanca (2026) | tabiji.ai
seo.metaDescription: Discover the 12 best brunch spots in Casablanca for 2026. From traditional Moroccan feasts to chic French bistros and healthy cafes, find your perfect weekend brunch experience in the city.

hero.subtitle: Casablanca's brunch scene is a vibrant mix of traditional Moroccan hospitality, elegant French influences, and modern, health-conscious cafes, offering a perfect start to any weekend.

picks.name: Maison B
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Maison B is a stylish and perpetually buzzing spot in the upscale Gauthier neighborhood, known for its chic decor and exquisite culinary offerings. Their brunch menu is a sophisticated blend of international classics and Moroccan-inspired dishes, all presented beautifully. It's a favorite among locals for its lively atmosphere and consistently high quality.
picks.whatToOrder: The 'Avocado Toast with Poached Eggs' and their fresh 'Mini Viennoiseries Basket' with Moroccan tea.
picks.insiderTip: Reservations are highly recommended, especially on weekends, as it gets very crowded. Arrive early if you want a prime spot on the terrace.
picks.redditQuote: "Maison B's brunch is next level, definitely worth the hype. Their pastries are divine and the vibe is just *chef's kiss*."

picks.name: La Sqala
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Nestled within the ramparts of the Old Medina, La Sqala offers an unparalleled brunch experience in a historic, Andalusian-style garden. Famous for its traditional Moroccan breakfast and fresh seafood, it's a sensory feast where you can enjoy authentic tagines, fresh pastries, and refreshing mint tea under ancient fig trees. The ambiance is truly unique and transportive.
picks.whatToOrder: The 'Moroccan Brunch Set' (Ftour Beldi) which includes msemen, harcha, amlou, honey, olives, and fresh juices.
picks.insiderTip: Ask for a table in the garden to fully immerse yourself in the beautiful, serene setting. It's also a great spot to explore the nearby Old Medina after your meal.
picks.redditQuote: "La Sqala is an absolute must-do for brunch in Casablanca. The garden, the food... it's like stepping into another world. Their Ftour Beldi is legendary."

picks.name: Organic Kitchen
picks.whyItMadeTheList: For health-conscious diners, Organic Kitchen is a gem offering a fresh and wholesome brunch experience. Emphasizing organic, locally sourced ingredients, their menu features vibrant salads, nutrient-packed smoothie bowls, and creative egg dishes. The bright, minimalist decor provides a refreshing and calm atmosphere perfect for a relaxed start to the day.
picks.whatToOrder: The 'Açaí Bowl' or the 'Smoked Salmon Benedict' with a fresh-pressed juice.
picks.insiderTip: They have a small shop section where you can purchase organic produce, healthy snacks, and artisanal goods. Great for stocking up on quality ingredients.
picks.redditQuote: "I always hit up Organic Kitchen for brunch when I'm in Casa. Their avocado toast is perfect, and I never feel guilty after! So many good vegan options too."

picks.name: Paul
picks.neighborhood: Multiple Locations (e.g., Anfa Place Mall, Maarif)
picks.whyItMadeTheList: The French bakery chain Paul brings a classic Parisian brunch experience to Casablanca. With several convenient locations, it's known for its authentic viennoiseries, freshly baked breads, quiches, and simple yet elegant egg dishes. It's a reliable choice for a consistently good quality, relaxed brunch in a family-friendly setting.
picks.whatToOrder: A 'Croque Madame' paired with a fresh croissant and a café au lait.
picks.insiderTip: Consider grabbing some pastries or a baguette from their bakery counter to take home; they are always fresh and delicious.
picks.redditQuote: "You can't go wrong with Paul for a reliable brunch. Their pain au chocolat tastes just like Paris, and the coffee is solid."

picks.name: Le Gatsby
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Le Gatsby offers a luxurious and sophisticated brunch experience reminiscent of the Roaring Twenties. With its elegant Art Deco interior and refined menu, it's perfect for a special occasion. Expect meticulously prepared dishes, from gourmet eggs benedict to delectable desserts, all served with impeccable service in an exclusive atmosphere.
picks.whatToOrder: The 'Oeufs Bénédicte au Saumon' or their seasonal 'Brunch Menu' for a curated experience.
picks.insiderTip: Dress code is smart casual. It's an ideal spot for a romantic brunch or an important business meeting.
picks.redditQuote: "Le Gatsby for brunch is pure indulgence. It's pricey but the atmosphere and the quality of the food make it worth it for a fancy treat."

picks.name: Lily's Cafe
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Lily's Cafe is a charming and bright spot in Maarif, popular for its delicious and health-conscious brunch options. The menu features a variety of creative toasts, fresh salads, smoothie bowls, and excellent coffee. Its minimalist yet warm interior makes it a comfortable place to relax and enjoy a nutritious meal.
picks.whatToOrder: The 'Avocado Toast with Feta and Pomegranate' or their 'Pancakes with Berries'.
picks.insiderTip: They often have unique daily specials, so check the board or ask your server for recommendations beyond the regular menu.
picks.redditQuote: "Lily's has the best avocado toast in Maarif, hands down. Plus, their coffee is strong and the place has a great vibe for catching up with friends."

picks.name: Corniche Club
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Situated right on the Ain Diab Corniche, the Corniche Club offers a fantastic brunch experience with stunning ocean views. Their menu is a mix of fresh seafood, international breakfast staples, and local favorites, all enjoyed with the sound of waves. It's a perfect spot for a leisurely weekend brunch with a sea breeze.
picks.whatToOrder: The 'Seafood Omelette' or a selection from their 'Continental Breakfast' while enjoying the view.
picks.insiderTip: Try to get a table on the outdoor terrace for the best views, especially on a sunny day. Parking can be a bit tricky on busy weekends.
picks.redditQuote: "Brunch at Corniche Club is my go-to for a relaxed Sunday. The view is amazing, and their fresh orange juice really hits the spot."

picks.name: Le Bistrot de la Fabrique
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Bringing a piece of rustic French charm to Casablanca, Le Bistrot de la Fabrique in Oasis is celebrated for its authentic bistro ambiance and hearty brunch. Expect classic French dishes like Croque Monsieur, gourmet omelettes, and rich coffee in a cozy, unpretentious setting. It's a local favorite for its consistent quality and welcoming atmosphere.
picks.whatToOrder: The 'French Toast with Berries' or a classic 'Steak Frites' (if you're feeling adventurous for brunch).
picks.insiderTip: They have a lovely outdoor seating area, which is perfect during cooler months. It's a great spot for a relaxed family meal.
picks.redditQuote: "Le Bistrot de la Fabrique feels like a little piece of Paris in Casa. Their brunch is solid, especially if you're craving proper French cooking. Love the cozy vibe."

picks.name: Amoud
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Amoud is a household name in Casablanca, renowned for its extensive range of freshly baked breads, pastries, and traditional Moroccan sweets. While primarily a bakery, many locations offer cafe seating perfect for a casual and affordable brunch. You can assemble your own meal from their delicious offerings, from harcha to croissants, paired with excellent coffee or mint tea.
picks.whatToOrder: A selection of 'Mini Harcha' and 'Msemen', alongside a fresh 'Jus d'Orange' and a 'Café Noir'.
picks.insiderTip: Don't miss their diverse selection of Moroccan cookies and cakes, which make for perfect souvenirs or gifts. It's a great spot for a quick and satisfying bite.
picks.redditQuote: "If you want a cheap, delicious, and quick brunch, Amoud is the answer. Their pastries are legendary, and you can't beat the price for what you get."

picks.name: Blend Gourmand
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Blend Gourmand is a chic patisserie and cafe known for its exquisite desserts and lighter brunch fare. Their menu includes beautifully crafted pastries, savory tartines, and fresh salads, making it ideal for a sweet and elegant brunch. The sophisticated decor and attention to detail extend from the ambiance to every plate.
picks.whatToOrder: Any of their 'Éclairs' or 'Macarons' paired with a 'Salmon Tartine' and a freshly brewed coffee.
picks.insiderTip: It's an excellent spot for afternoon tea as well, offering a refined selection of teas and delicate sweets. Perfect for a leisurely catch-up.
picks.redditQuote: "Blend Gourmand is my go-to for a fancy-ish, light brunch. Their desserts are works of art, and the coffee is strong, just how I like it. So Parisian."

picks.name: Le Doge Relais & Châteaux
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Housed within the opulent Art Deco Le Doge Relais & Châteaux hotel, the brunch here is an experience in luxury and refinement. Expect an expansive buffet featuring an array of gourmet dishes, from fresh seafood and artisanal cheeses to elaborate pastries and live cooking stations. It's a truly indulgent affair in a stunning historic setting.
picks.whatToOrder: Indulge in their 'Signature Brunch Buffet' which offers a vast selection, ensuring there's something exquisite for every palate.
picks.insiderTip: This is a prime choice for a celebratory brunch. Dress elegantly to match the sophisticated ambiance. Reservations are essential.
picks.redditQuote: "If you're looking to splurge on an incredible brunch, Le Doge is it. The buffet is insane, seriously so many options and everything is top-notch. Feel like royalty there."

picks.name: La Croisière
picks.whyItMadeTheList: La Croisière offers a relaxed and unpretentious brunch experience right on the Ain Diab Corniche, providing pleasant sea views without the upscale price tag. It's a solid choice for a casual meal, featuring a mix of classic breakfast items, local fare, and simple international dishes. Great for families or a straightforward, enjoyable meal by the ocean.
picks.whatToOrder: A classic 'Continental Breakfast' or their 'Moroccan Assortment' with a view of the Atlantic.
picks.insiderTip: It's usually less crowded than some of the more famous spots on the Corniche, making it a good option if you want a quicker and more relaxed experience.
picks.redditQuote: "La Croisière is a dependable spot on the Corniche for an easy brunch. Nothing fancy, but the food is good, the prices are fair, and you can't beat the ocean breeze."

faq.question: What is a typical Moroccan brunch like?
faq.answer: A traditional Moroccan brunch, often called 'Ftour Beldi' (traditional breakfast), is a rich and savory affair. It typically includes fresh bread (khobz), semolina pancakes (baghrir), flatbreads (harcha and msemen) served with honey, amlou (almond butter with argan oil), cheese, olives, and sometimes eggs. It's always accompanied by strong Moroccan mint tea or coffee.

faq.question: Do I need reservations for brunch in Casablanca?
faq.answer: For popular brunch spots like Maison B, La Sqala, or Le Gatsby, especially on weekends (Saturday and Sunday), reservations are highly recommended, if not essential. For smaller cafes or bakeries like Amoud or Paul, reservations are usually not needed, but arriving early is always a good idea to secure a table.

faq.question: What are the common brunch hours in Casablanca?
faq.answer: Most brunch spots in Casablanca serve from around 10:00 AM to 3:00 PM on weekends. Some cafes may open earlier for breakfast, with their brunch menu transitioning from late morning. It's always best to check the specific opening hours of the venue you plan to visit.

faq.question: Are there vegetarian or vegan brunch options available?
faq.answer: Yes, Casablanca's brunch scene is increasingly accommodating to dietary preferences. Many cafes, particularly those focused on healthy eating like Organic Kitchen or Lily's Cafe, offer extensive vegetarian and vegan options, including açaí bowls, avocado toasts, and plant-based dishes. Traditional Moroccan brunches also often feature many naturally vegetarian elements like bread, olives, and spreads.

faq.question: What is the price range for brunch in Casablanca?
faq.answer: The price range for brunch in Casablanca varies significantly. A casual brunch at a bakery or cafe might cost MAD 70-120 ($7-12) per person. Mid-range options typically fall between MAD 150-250 ($15-25), while upscale or hotel brunches can range from MAD 250-500+ ($25-50+) per person, especially for all-you-can-eat buffets.

faq.question: Is it customary to tip for brunch in Casablanca?
faq.answer: Tipping is customary in Casablanca, though not mandatory, and generally appreciated. For good service at a brunch spot, a tip of 5-10% of the total bill is appropriate. For exceptional service, you might round up or leave a bit more, especially if paying in cash.

methodology: Our selection of Casablanca's best brunch spots is curated through extensive local research, diner reviews, and expert recommendations. We prioritize venues offering excellent food quality, unique ambiance, consistent service, and value across various price points and culinary styles to ensure a diverse and reliable guide.
